This document demonstrates the `support-this` Quarto extension with multiple funding platforms configured directly in the document's YAML front matter.

## Configuration

We have specified the following configuration:

```yaml
extensions:
  support-this:
    display: badge
    heading: "Support My Work"
    description: "If you find this helpful, consider supporting me!"
    platforms:
      github: coatless
      patreon: coatless
      buy_me_a_coffee: coatless
filters: [support-this]
```

Make sure to replace `coatless` with your actual usernames on the respective platforms.

## Supported Formats

This page is also rendered to PDF, Typst, and Word; use the links under "Other Formats" to compare them.

- **HTML** shows the styled section below, here with `display: badge`.
- **PDF, Typst, and Word** show the section as a note callout titled with the `heading`. Badges are HTML only, so these formats use the default icon, platform, and username display. Typst shows the platforms' icons, Word a symbol for each, and PDF leaves them out, since LaTeX's default fonts can't display them.
- **RevealJS** adds the section as a slide of its own; see [RevealJS Integration](qsupport-this-revealjs.qmd).
